orientations.intent: Determine whether any available tools (repo, tests, git, episodes) can upload the golden file to object storage.
Check if tests tool can upload golden file to object storage
Check if episodes tool can upload golden file to object storage

final_message: No — none of the available tools (repo, tests, git, episodes) can upload the golden file to object storage. The "tests" and "episodes" handles explicitly report that this capability is unavailable, and the "repo"/"git" handles only expose local repository operations (status, etc.), with no object storage upload functionality.
